Do you have pages for individual complexes?
Yes. Greenway, Jacobsen, The Heights, SOHO, South Village, Hyde Park, Arista, Blu Living and Fox and Aikins North each have a page with current listings.
What should I check in a townhome's strata documents?

Request the Form B Information Certificate, plus the budget, the depreciation report, recent minutes and the bylaws. The Strata Property Act requires the strata to hand over the Form B within one week.
Can a strata stop me from renting out my townhome?
No, not any longer. As of November 2022, strata bylaws in BC cannot ban or restrict rentals, though age limits for 55+ buildings are still permitted.
Can I back out after my offer is accepted?
Buyers in BC get a rescission period. Within three business days of acceptance you can cancel, but doing so costs you 0.25% of the purchase price, paid to the seller.
